ping-pong.name: Ping pong
ping-pong.blurb: Table tennis against the computer on a 3D table.

ping-pong.q1: How do you play ping pong here?
ping-pong.a1: Move your paddle to meet the ball after it bounces once on your side. Where the ball meets the paddle sets the direction: the left edge sends it left, the right edge right. Win a point when the computer misses, hits into the net or hits the ball out.
ping-pong.q2: How do I serve and swing?
ping-pong.a2: Click, tap or press Space. On your serve that tosses and serves the ball; in a rally it adds pace to your next hit. Moving the paddle toward the net as you hit also makes the shot faster and deeper.
ping-pong.a3: Table tennis rules, simplified: the ball must bounce once on each side, a serve bounces on your half first, and a serve that clips the net and lands in is a let and is played again. Serves change every two points, and every point from 10–10. The first to 11 wins, by two clear points.
ping-pong.a4: Easy reacts late and makes many mistakes, Normal is steadier, and Hard moves fast, places the ball and rarely misses. Changing the level starts a new match.
ping-pong.a5: Yes. Your wins and losses at each level stay in this browser only. The 3D table loads when you press Play.

ping-pong.lead: Play ping pong in three steps.
ping-pong.s1b: Press Play, then click, tap or press Space to serve. Your serve bounces on your half first.
ping-pong.s2b: Move the paddle with the mouse, a finger or the arrow keys and meet the ball after it bounces on your side. Aim with the edge of the paddle.
ping-pong.s3b: Win points when the computer misses or hits out. The first to 11, two points clear, wins the match.

pingPong.title: Ping pong
pingPong.privacyNote: Play table tennis against the computer on a 3D table. Your record stays in this browser.
pingPong.intro: Move your paddle with the mouse, a finger or the arrow keys. Click, tap or press Space to serve and to hit harder. First to 11 wins.
pingPong.yourServe: your serve: click, tap or Space
pingPong.let: Let: the serve clipped the net. Serve again.
pingPong.r_own: it bounced on the hitter's own side
pingPong.r_dead: the ball died on the table
pingPong.hint: Mouse or finger: the paddle follows the pointer at your end of the table. Keyboard: arrow keys or W A S D move it, Space serves and swings. Where the ball meets the paddle sets its direction.
